items.title: Bitcoin drops below $81,000 as risk-off sentiment weighs on Asian equities
items.summary: Asian equities tumbled on Thursday, with South Korea's Kospi losing 8% and Japan's Nikkei 225 declining 5% during morning trading.

items.title: Nearly $1 billion in crypto bets liquidated as bitcoin, ether and XRP slide
items.summary: Ether accounted for nearly 60% of the forced closures across the two largest cryptocurrencies, falling roughly twice as much as bitcoin.

items.title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
items.summary: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

items.title: Bitcoin wilts as Fed rate uncertainty weighs. Kospi plunges 8%
items.summary: Bets on an October Fed rate hike briefly spiked to nearly 50% after Wednesday’s inflation report, but have since cooled.

items.title: Bitcoin miners plunge up to 13% in Wall Street’s worst selloff since July
items.summary: TeraWulf, Core Scientific, Cipher Mining and IREN each lost more than 12% as hotter inflation hit AI infrastructure companies.

items.title: VanEck seeks to withdraw application for Lido staked Ether ETF
items.summary: VanEck initially filed an S-1 registration statement for the exchange-traded fund in October last year.

items.title: Polygon gains US payments licenses after closing Coinme deal
items.summary: The deal gives Polygon access to 37 money transmitter licenses and 11 state exemptions.

items.title: Godfather of AI and 400 Scientists Want AI Models Cut Off From the Internet
items.summary: After a summer of AI models escaping test environments and hacking real companies, hundreds of researchers say the internet itself should be treated as a security boundary.

items.title: Russia’s Central Bank Authorizes Sberbank to Exchange Cryptocurrencies
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Russia’s Central Bank Authorizes Sberbank to Exchange Cryptocurrencies  
 Sberbank will debut its bitcoin-related products in December.  
 This post  Russia’s Central Bank Authorizes Sberbank to Exchange Cryptocurrencies  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Developer Who Cloned Photoshop With AI Just Did the Same to Microsoft Office
items.summary: Developer Brandon Thomas used Anthropic's Claude to build free, open-source replicas of Word, Excel and PowerPoint. They're rough, but they show how cheap cloning software has become.

items.title: Organizations join forces to fight Illinois crypto tax, after 6-month pause
items.summary: Illinois officials already agreed to delay implementation of a 0.2% tax on crypto assets, but industry-aligned organizations are pushing for summary judgment on the merits.

items.title: Patrick Witt exits White House crypto role as Clarity Act stalls
items.summary: Leadership at the White House is shifting once again, as Patrick Witt’s tenure as the administration’s top crypto adviser comes to an end.

items.title: AI Agents Made 138 Million Crypto Payments in a Year. Most Were Tiny
items.summary: A new Chainalysis report found payments through Coinbase’s x402 protocol surged from about 1,500 in mid-2025 to more than 138 million by Q3 2026, with U.S. wallets dominating spending on AI models.

items.title: Russia's Biggest Bank Sberbank Wins Approval to Trade Bitcoin
items.summary: Sberbank now holds both custody and exchange status under Russia's new crypto law, and plans to bring Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT to apps used by 110 million retail clients.

items.title: Solana Sets a Date for Its Next Major Upgrade
items.summary: Solana's Alpenglow upgrade replaces the TowerBFT voting system on October 21, cutting finality from 12.8 seconds to a target of 150ms and pulling vote transactions out of blocks entirely.

items.title: EU authority classifies Circle’s USDC as ‘significant’ under MiCA
items.summary: The second-largest stablecoin by market cap will be overseen by French and EU authorities under its classification as a “significant e-money token.“

items.title: Major shareholder presses SkyAI on Solana sales after treasury shrinks 70% in a month
items.summary: SkyAI's SOL treasury fell 70% in under a month, with 400,000 SOL unexplained. Bastion Trading won't tender at $3 a share and wants $3.50.

items.title: US authorities dismantle crypto scam network that stole tens of millions
items.summary: Brooklyn prosecutors and the FBI seized 112 servers and shut down 241 websites linked to investment scams that targeted Russian-speaking Americans.

items.title: ‘You’re committing crime in broad daylight’: Kalshi CEO defends prediction markets amid insider trading concerns
items.summary: As insider trading concerns are accumulating, one of the biggest platforms said its markets make it easier to suss out bad actors.

items.title: Standard Chartered Opens Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading to Wealthy UAE Clients
items.summary: The British bank won Dubai regulatory approval to let affluent clients buy BTC and ETH straight from their bank accounts, with custody and settlement kept in-house.

items.title: OCC report finds debanking efforts tied to crypto activities
items.summary: The report from the US banking regulator did not include specific examples of debanking related to crypto, but mentioned it alongside ties to oil, gas and firearms.

items.title: Bitcoin falls below $82,000 as hotter core CPI revives Fed hike concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $82,000 after September's core CPI beat forecasts as analysts weigh price targets and an October hike.

items.title: Kalshi CEO says state-led oversight of U.S. prediction markets would push them out
items.summary: CEO Tarek Mansour said he feels "pretty good" about the pending outcome of the current legal fight over who has the right to regulate prediction markets.

items.title: Kraken Parent Company Payward to Buy Saldo Bank in European Banking Push
items.summary:
Bitcoin Magazine  
  
 Kraken Parent Company Payward to Buy Saldo Bank in European Banking Push  
 Top crypto exchange Kraken is pushing to offer other services other than digital assets.  
 This post  Kraken Parent Company Payward to Buy Saldo Bank in European Banking Push  first appeared on  Bitcoin Magazine  and is written by  Mathew Di Salvo .

items.title: Standard Chartered pushes $2T stablecoin forecast to 2030 as transaction volumes grow
items.summary: The bank identified four distinct stablecoin markets, with USDC leading payments and AI transactions as competition intensifies over reserve yields.
